# Cloudflare Skills provenance

Imported from the official Cloudflare Skills repository for ATLAS GitHub Copilot agent mode.

- Source: https://github.com/cloudflare/skills
- Upstream ref: `main`
- Upstream commit: `6dc7604903127485e7e4cb26314651ebd4a4df19`
- Imported skills: `agents-sdk`, `cloudflare-one`, `durable-objects`, `web-perf`, `workers-best-practices`, `wrangler`
- Scope: project-local Copilot skills under `.github/skills/`
- Secrets: none copied

The repository Cloudflare MCP configuration uses Cloudflare-managed remote MCP endpoints. OAuth is completed by the user on first authenticated MCP use; credentials are not stored in this repository.
